_comment: S2S bring-up profile. Select with `CodeReviewDaemon --review s2s`. Runs the review INSIDE a separate LmStreaming.Sample review host (http://localhost:5051) over the S2S REST API instead of an in-process agent loop, so the posted comment can deep-link the real conversation + its code-reviewer:* sub-agent tree. Deliberately isolated from the live poster profile (appsettings.achieveai.json): its own port, DB, log and conversation store, so the two never share state. SECRET: LmStreamingS2SSecret is NOT stored here — pass it as env CodeReviewDaemon__LmStreamingS2SSecret, matching the review host's Auth__S2SInboundSecret. Shared-gateway invariant: SandboxGateway:WorkspaceBasePath must equal the gateway's WORKSPACE_BASE_HOST_PATH, and PerAppWorkspaceRooting+AppId must match what the daemon forwards as X-Sbx-App-Id, so the leaf the preparer clones into is the leaf the gateway mounts. Workspace isolation: each review leases a pooled slot whose directory is a SINGLE segment under the daemon's effective app base ({base}/review-slot-{i}) — LmStreaming's workspace-directory sanitizer strips path separators, so a nested name would silently resolve to a different, empty directory. That leaf mounts at /workspace, which is why the hosted agent sees /workspace/store, /workspace/store/repos/<Repo> and /workspace/store/PRs/<slug>-<pr> exactly as the pooled review stage computes them.

Github._comment: GitHub CLI (gh) first-party OAuth App id + secret (public, safe to embed — same convention as appsettings.achieveai.json). Lets the auth-webhook inject the stored token for the review agent's api.github.com calls.

CodeReviewDaemon._DeepLinkRetentionHours_comment: Maximum lifetime of a review deep-link. Every posted comment carries {LmStreamingBaseUrl}/?threadId=...&focus=1, so the hosted conversation must OUTLIVE the review that minted it — this is a CEILING, never a teardown hook: nothing here is triggered by a review finishing, a slot being returned or a PR closing, only by age since the conversation was minted. The poller's maintenance tick discards expired ones. Every arm is covered (review, judge, A/B), because the retention ledger is written at the single mint choke point rather than off the artifact that records only the primary review's thread id. 0 or negative keeps conversations forever.
CodeReviewDaemon._LmStreamingProviderId_comment: Provision carries no model field — the model is whatever this LmStreaming provider resolves. gpt-5.6-luna mirrors the achieveai profile's ReviewModelId and is a Copilot-backed (non-CLI) provider, which workspace-agent mode requires.
CodeReviewDaemon._EnableToolAssistedReview_comment: ON, but it means something different here. On the S2S path 'tool-assisted' does NOT mean the daemon provisions its own review sandbox — it does not; the tools, MCP transport and code-reviewer:* sub-agents all live inside the LmStreaming-hosted conversation. What the flag buys is the POOLED path: with EnableReviewerWrites + a resolved store it leases a warm ReviewSlot, prepares it host-side (store + KnowledgeBase + the PR's notes branch + the PR head checked out), and that leased slot is the directory mounted into the hosted conversation at /workspace. That is what makes notes, per-PR memory and KB grounding real on S2S. The flag name is shared by all three profiles, so it keeps its original name and this comment carries the truth.
CodeReviewDaemon._RequireSkillSupport_comment: Fail-fast: Revobot must not review without the skills/agents it reviews WITH. On the in-process path this asserts the daemon's own sandbox session discovered code-reviewer:* sub-agents; on S2S the daemon provisions no session, so the equivalent check reads the GATEWAY's marketplace catalog (GET api/v1/marketplaces/preview over SubAgentMarketplaces) and requires both the code-reviewer:pr-review skill — daemon-prompts.yaml makes it mandatory, 'that skill IS how you review' — and at least one code-reviewer:* agent. Missing ⇒ log Critical and stop the daemon rather than posting a shallow review that merely looks like one. An UNREADABLE catalog (gateway down) is not this failure: it warns and re-probes next run, since a genuinely down gateway fails the run loudly when the review host provisions its session.
CodeReviewDaemon._EnableReviewerWrites_comment: The reviewer writes PR_Context_NN.md / PR_Findings_NN.md into its notes dir. No in-process tool filter can wrap the hosted agent's Write/Edit on S2S, and no read-only mount stands in for one either (a per-path RO bind mount is unavailable — see the R1 resolution in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-05-daemon-pooled-review-workspace-design.md), so the enforcement boundary is the COMMIT GATE: the daemon stages only the PR's notes dir, the write credential never enters the agent session, and anything written elsewhere in the slot is erased by SlotHygiene's strip + clean-on-entry.
CodeReviewDaemon._EnableJudgeAgent_comment: The judge runs as a SEPARATE hosted conversation against the same slot workspace (so it shares the slot's container, not the review's thread). EnableABVariants stays off: a second full review arm doubles cost for a comparison this bring-up does not need.
CodeReviewDaemon._store_comment: The cross-repo store the pooled slots clone. Its submodule repos/<Repo> is the reviewed checkout, Contracts/ the shared layer, and KnowledgeBase/ what the review reads and the at-close extraction writes. Without this the pooled path returns false and S2S falls back to the bare per-PR clone.
CodeReviewDaemon._ReviewPoolSize_comment: One single-segment workspace leaf per slot ({base}/review-slot-{i}), each mounted as its own LmStreaming workspace ⇒ its own gateway container. Two concurrent reviews holding different leases share nothing. The poller is still serial, so this is warm-slot reuse today and the isolation that makes parallel a poller-only change later.
CodeReviewDaemon._KnowledgeModelId_comment: Deliberately UNSET here. KnowledgeModelId is a per-call model id, and provision on this path carries no model field (ProvisionConversationRequest is {WorkspaceId, ProviderId, ModeId}) — S2SReviewAgentLoopFactory.Create documents that it does not forward modelId. So on S2S the at-close extraction runs on whatever LmStreamingProviderId resolves, exactly like the review; setting it here would read as 'extraction runs on opus' while changing nothing. The achieveai/mcqdb (in-process) profiles do honour it.
CodeReviewDaemon._JudgeModelId_comment: Deliberately UNSET here, and REFUSED at boot on this path (Program.cs). Same reason as KnowledgeModelId above: provision carries no model field, so the judge conversation resolves its model from LmStreamingProviderId exactly as the review does. Setting it would read as 'the judge is independent' while the judge kept grading on the review's own model — the daemon fails fast instead. Unset, every judged run logs a Warning naming the self-preference, and the judge artifact records SelfGraded=true, so the bias is on the record rather than assumed away.
CodeReviewDaemon._MaxPrAgeDays_comment: Scopes this bring-up to the single recent PR under test (#222); the other open PRs are weeks older and fall outside the window.
